investigation.likely_cause: The /data volume on the subscriber DB server srv-db-01 is full (100%, 0.1 GiB free). The largest folder is /data/txlog_archive (8.5 GiB), and 8.5 GiB was written across 34 files in the last 15 minutes, which looks like an archive catch-up run rather than database growth. With less than 256 MiB free, the database refuses writes, so write errors appear on all schemas. The balance and bundle API errors, USSD timeouts and synthetic failures, and SMS queue growth are downstream symptoms.
